idea: 1 Waiting room. Pale green clinic. The TURKEY nurse at reception, typing, big enough to read. On the wall a red poster.
feel: The place and the product. Plants: the poster, the turkey.

idea: 1 Waiting room. HIM in a waiting chair. His fingers drum his knees to a beat only he hears. He hums.
feel: Plant: he hears music no one else can.

idea: 1 Waiting room. The poster, held 2 s so it reads: HAWKES PUNCH. Ask your doctor.
feel: Plant: the product's name and the tagline.

idea: 1 Waiting room. The TURKEY turns its head to him. He looks up, stands and goes in. Cut on his movement.
feel: Turn (+): he is called in.

idea: 2 Exam room. The exam room. HIM on the bed screen left, the window behind him. The DOCTOR at her desk screen right, kind smile. On the wall behind her: a framed pair of red boxing gloves and a plaque.
feel: Geography for the whole scene. Plant: the gloves (we see them, he doesn't).

idea: 2 Exam room. The DOCTOR, warm, pen ready.
feel: She invites the problem.

idea: 2 Exam room. HIM, facing her, a little too honest. His fingers drum the edge of the bed.
feel: Symptom 1 of 3.

idea: 2 Exam room. The DOCTOR nods, writes.
feel: Plant: silence = more music.

idea: 2 Exam room. HIM, lower, shy. Slow push-in: the confession is his.
feel: Symptom 2. The scene turns personal.

idea: 2 Exam room. Her pen stops mid-word.
feel: Symptom 3. The first crack in her calm.

idea: 2 Exam room. The DOCTOR looks up at him. Blank. Hold. (The pause before the punchline.)
feel: The pause.

idea: 2 Exam room. HIM, dreamy. He pulls a folded crayon drawing from his pocket and holds it up: a sheet ghost with no face.
feel: Plant: the faceless ghost, and the drawing he will carry to space.

idea: 2 Exam room. The DOCTOR, deadpan, writes it down.
feel: She takes it in stride: she has seen this before.

idea: 2 Exam room. HIM, hearing it said back to him.
feel: The reaction is the punchline.

idea: 2 Exam room. The boxing gloves on the wall, held 2 s. The plaque: GOLDEN GLOVES CHAMPION. We see it; he doesn't. The bomb under the table.
feel: Suspense: the audience now knows what the cure is.

idea: 3 The prescription. She smiles and slides a red can across the desk to him.
feel: Turn (+, for now): there is a cure. Plant: 'every day'.

idea: 3 The prescription. The can in his hand, big enough to read: HAWKES PUNCH. One a day until it stops.
feel: Plant: the red can (the ad, the ending).

idea: 3 The prescription. HIM, relieved, turns the can over.
feel: He hopes it is a drink.

idea: 3 The prescription. Pause. She stands, takes off her glasses, and her eyes go to the gloves on the wall.
feel: Turn begins (-): the cure is her fist.

idea: 3 The prescription. He follows her look to the gloves. Back to her.
feel: He finally sees the bomb.

idea: 3 The prescription. The DOCTOR rolls her shoulders. Flat, calm, terrifying. The register switches: low angle, hard rim light.
feel: Turn (-): hope to doom. The long build begins.

idea: 4 The punch. The wind-up, held: fist cocked behind her ear, torso twisted away, a tremble. He is in frame, within reach, frozen. Let the whole wind-up play in one shot.
feel: Anticipation. Both in one frame so the geography reads.

idea: 4 The punch. The hit. Her fist meets his jaw: IMPACT FRAME, black on white, radial lines. Hitstop. The loudest sound in the film.
feel: Resolution in 2 frames.

idea: 4 The punch. He rockets straight up through the ceiling. Tiles rain. She stands below, cold face, arm still extended.
feel: The cure administered. Her reaction (she owns the action).

idea: 4 The punch. Reception. The TURKEY looks up at the rattling ceiling as dust falls. Looks back at its screen. Types.
feel: The free laugh: the mundane reaction to the epic event.

idea: 4 The punch. He streaks up through the clouds, screaming. The sky goes from blue to deep blue to stars. Camera tilts up with him.
feel: Clinic to space in one move.

idea: 5 Arrival. The streak passes the Moon and sails toward Saturn, which grows from a dot to fill the frame. The instant he crosses the ring plane the scream cuts dead. He coasts to a stop, a tiny lit figure against the rings. Hold.
feel: World rule: planets are real size, a man is a speck. Sound to silence.

idea: 5 Arrival. Lit by ring light. 'Silence.' Hold. '...Nope. More music.' A thought lands; slow push in. He pulls the drawing from his pocket and holds it up.
feel: Payoff: silence = more music. He gets a goal: find her.

idea: 6 The search. He peers round a house-sized ice boulder, drawing held up, looking screen LEFT. Behind him screen RIGHT the GHOST rises from behind another boulder and looks at him. He turns; she sinks. Twice. Then a tap on his shoulder from off-frame right. He freezes.
feel: Suspense: we see her, he doesn't. Then he is found, by the wrong one.

idea: 6 The search. He turns: it is HIM, in a red tee, screen right. The DOUBLE looks at the drawing, then at him. Long deadpan hold. Then the double boops his nose, drifts back grinning, and leaves in a streak.
feel: Rule of three broken: not the ghost, a double. He has company he didn't ask for.

idea: 7a The chase. Left to right: the DOUBLE blasts straight through Saturn's ring, ice exploding behind him in a long wake. HIM follows through the same hole; his wake is twice as big.
feel: His goal: catch him for an answer. He is as strong as the double.

idea: 7b The moon. A small grey moon's horizon. HIM sneaks along the surface. The DOUBLE pops up over the horizon: BOO! The startle flings his fist straight down into the moon: IMPACT FRAME.
feel: Power by accident: his flinch cracks a moon.

idea: 7b The moon. From high orbit: two lit specks above the grey moon. A city-sized crater blooms under them, a slow shock ring, a dust plume. Then near silence.
feel: The scale cut: face to a dot against a world.

idea: 7b The moon. Both float side by side and look down at the fresh crater filling the bottom of frame. Dust settles. 1.5 s hold before the line.
feel: The bigger the feat, the smaller the reaction.

idea: 7c The worlds. The DOUBLE grips the edge of Saturn's ring and pulls: the whole ring lifts off like a hoop. He spins it overhead like a lasso and throws. The loop sails across and drops over JUPITER. He yanks. Jupiter starts to move.
feel: Escalation 3: a planet is coming.

idea: 7c The worlds. Low on HIM, Jupiter filling the whole sky behind and coming at him. He braces, arms out, a tremble. CATCH: impact frame, hitstop, a shockwave across the cloud bands. He slides back thousands of km, heels carving speed lines in nothing.
feel: The finisher: the biggest hit in the film, a planet caught.

idea: 7c The worlds. Palms flat on a wall of storm clouds, a hurricane bigger than Earth turning beside his head. Beat of 1.5 s. 'Okay.' He shoves it back where it was.
feel: Payoff hold: he is unimpressed. The double has to go bigger.

idea: 7d The break. The DOUBLE, Atlas-style, winds up overhead with the EARTH: clouds, city lights on the night side. HIM small at screen left, plain.
feel: The rule of three breaks: this one he stops.

idea: 7d The break. HIM, plain. No gesture.
feel: Absurd literal-mindedness stops the game.

idea: 7d The break. The DOUBLE looks up at the city lights. Long beat. Then very carefully he flies the Earth back and sets it into orbit like a full glass. A small pat. It keeps turning.
feel: Turn: rivals to truce. The careful set-down is the joke.

idea: 8 The stop. Above Earth at sunrise, out of breath, face to face. 'Are you... the space ghost?' 'No, man. I'm you.' Pause. He looks at the double's face. 'You do have a face.' He looks at the drawing and lets it go. It drifts off toward the sunrise.
feel: Turn (+): lonely to not alone. Payoff of 'she doesn't have a face'. The drawing released.

idea: 8 The stop. Side by side. The drawing drifts past the GHOST, who catches it, looks at it, and seems pleased. Neither notices. He starts to turn; the double turns his chin back. Then both turn to camera with TV smiles.
feel: The ghost pays off for us, not him. The story becomes the ad.

idea: 9 The commercial. Space folds away like a set. Behind it: a pastel daytime-TV studio, a giant Hawkes Punch can, the two of them on stools, lights and a boom mic.
feel: The reveal: it was a commercial all along.

idea: 9 The commercial. To lens, TV smiles, cans in hand.
feel: Payoff: the double was the spokesman all along.

idea: 9 The commercial. The clinic set. The DOCTOR at her desk, not looking up. Lower third: A REAL DOCTOR / Not looking up.
feel: Payoff: 'healthy amount of people'; she never looks up.

idea: 9 The commercial. They drink. He beams. The double pumps a fist.
feel: Payoff: the can and the fist are the same product.

idea: 9 The commercial. Important Safety Information card, held so it can be read. The ANNOUNCER reads the side effects fast and flat: sudden flight, meeting yourself, throwing planets, briefly holding the Earth, music in total silence, falling in love with a space ghost...
feel: The list is everything we just saw.

idea: 9 The commercial. End card: HAWKES PUNCH. Ask your doctor.
feel: Payoff of the poster.

idea: 10 The next day. The same exam room, the same framing as c05. Card: THE NEXT DAY. He sits on the bed. She writes, not looking up.
feel: Payoff: 'every day'.

idea: 10 The next day. HIM, dreamy. Her fist enters frame from off screen. CRACK. HARD CUT.
feel: The edge of the frame hides the punch. Payoff: he has a new symptom.

idea: 10 The next day. A streak leaves the Earth again. He coasts in above it.
feel: Same time, same place.

idea: 10 The next day. The DOUBLE waits with two cans. HIM coasts in and takes one. Clink. They drink. Behind them, out of focus, the GHOST holds the drawing and waves at us.
feel: Payoff: the daily dose is a friend. The ghost waves at the audience.

idea: 10 The next day. Black. A red can rolls into frame. Stops.
feel: The last image is the product.
